nodes.label: ADR-008: palette derivation, no WCAG enforcement
nodes.rationale: Custom palettes derive card/muted/border/foreground tokens from 3 anchor colors via fixed color-mix math; deliberately no WCAG contrast enforcement, so a user can pick low-contrast anchors -- accepted as out of scope. destructive/success colors are also fixed outside the palette so danger/success never drift with the chosen accent.
